title: Job applications
description: The import format (scripts/import_applications.py) and the export format (export workflow). status and source must be names from config.yaml (statuses[].name, sources[].option); the script checks them.

id.description: Stable and unique: the row number of the source, or a hash. The import uses it to skip what is already imported.

withdrawn.description: You stopped the process (the label withdrawn interest)

source.description: A sources[].option of config.yaml, or empty: guessed from the link

period.description: Job search period; empty: the year of date

lastUpdate.description: The last real event, YYYY-MM-DD (not a plan)

notes.description: Free text, in the original language

original.description: The raw source row, for traceability (not imported)
